notes.title: Watchmakers NextFest Developer Playthrough #2
notes.content:
The developers, Alexia and Bo, will be playing through Watchmakers and answering questions about development and the design of the world. 

We're excited to share this demo with you, which is just a portion of the entire world and characters we plan on releasing int he final version. We'll go through one of the puzzles and talk about what you can expect from the final release of the game, all the way up until making that important delivery to the Wizzy.
